we_do.title: Our Solutions
we_do.intro: Transforming operational complexity into business continuity
we_do.intro_par1: We accompany capital-intensive organizations to elevate their performance through world-class asset management. We are not external consultants; we integrate as part of your team to ensure every technical solution translates into real and sustainable improvement in the field.
we_do.intro_par2: With a presence throughout Latin America, we combine expert diagnostics with disciplined execution that drives decision-making based on real and real-time data.
we_do.job: Integral Solutions for Asset Management and Reliability
we_do.par_job: At GMN®, we transform maintenance into a profitability engine. Through an ecosystem that integrates technology, data analysis, and strategy, we cover the entire asset lifecycle —from the Technological Core in SAP PM to Reliability Engineering— to guarantee measurable and sustainable results over time.
we_do.par11: We ensure your critical assets exceed design levels through advanced reliability methodologies.
we_do.par12: We diagnose the real behavior of your equipment to eliminate systemic constraints and chronic failures that interrupt continuity.
we_do.par13: From the value chain to specific interventions, we guarantee more stable processes and an operation aligned with your production goals.
we_do.par21: We transform visible inefficiencies into strategic savings.
we_do.par22: We optimize key resources through a proprietary inventory management methodology that allows for asset recovery, elimination of historical overstock, and the cleanup of processes that generate silent losses.
we_do.par23: The result is robust operational financial control and a competitive cost structure supported by data.
we_do.par31: We take your management to the next level through the integration of SAP, Advanced Reporting in Power BI, and Artificial Intelligence.
we_do.par32: We develop digital ecosystems that detect deviations in real-time and propose immediate actions.
we_do.par33: We convert massive data flows into strategic insights, increasing predictability, agility, and transparency across your entire operation.

about_us.title1: GMN® DNA: 25 years transforming the industry
about_us.par11: GLOBAL MAINTENANCE NETWORK®, also known as GMN® by its initials, is a consultancy specialized in physical asset management, with more than 25 years of experience supporting mining, oil & gas, energy, and manufacturing operations in LATAM & Globally.
about_us.par12: Our approach integrates SAP PM technology, advanced analytics, and world-class methodology to generate measurable and sustainable results.
about_us.par13: Our history is written in mining sites, power plants, and logistics centers, where we have empowered industrial leaders through measurable results that last over time.
about_us.par21: To consolidate ourselves as the global benchmark in Physical Asset Management, driven by high-performance teams that redefine our clients' operational success through excellence and applied innovation.
about_us.par31: To ensure our clients' competitiveness and sustainability through agile solutions that maximize their economic value. We achieve this through sustainable growth, ensuring that each asset reaches its maximum return potential.
about_us.subtitle4: Leadership with purpose: We make things happen
about_us.par41: We believe in leadership that gets involved on the ground. Our executives combine strategic vision with decades of real-world execution in the most demanding industries.
about_us.bio_SA: Strategist with three decades leading operational excellence and supply chain projects. His approach integrates Asset Management with a systemic vision of process optimization to generate real value.
about_us.bio_MM: With more than 13 years of experience in the national and multinational mining industry, Marcelo leads the expansion of GMN® through strategic alliances and rigorous evaluation of high-criticality projects.

news.title: News
news.subtitle: The engine to recover mining competitiveness
news.par1: In an interview with Reporte Minero, our Managing Director, Sergio Adauy, analyzed the competitiveness gap facing the industry, highlighting that productivity has fallen by 27% over the last two decades. Given rising costs and lower ore grades, Adauy emphasized that maintenance represents about one-third of the operating cost (OPEX) of a site.
news.par2: From the GMN® perspective, the solution lies not only in traditional cost reduction but in Physical and Human Asset Management with a long-term vision. Productivity is not the same as production, underlining that the key lies in integrating advanced technology with highly trained work teams to ensure business continuity in highly complex scenarios.
